scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @report/entry build && pnpm --filter @report/view build:office && node scripts/copy-web.mjs
scripts.office: pnpm build:web && cd apps/office && export POS_REPORT_HOME=../../.office-dev PYTHONPATH=src && python3 -m report_office setup && python3 -m report_office serve
scripts.test:office: cd apps/office && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
